svg.title: spiral-expanding bore - section 6 of 10, bend DDDDDLLLLLLUUUUUUUUR~f, 10 parts on 586x194mm
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. 10mm square bore in 3mm stock, cut for a 3mm sheet at 0.15mm kerf, so a 16mm block pitch; a block that runs straight is 16mm long and a block that turns is a 16mm cube. Blocks 18-38 of the walk, entering on N and leaving on E, a 7x9 block plate laid flat. Two face plates (mirror images) and the side walls; every part carries the section number only. Inner cuts are the port and come before their outline. black #000000 cuts, blue #0000ff engraves.
